case_name: Deo Prakash vs Smt. Usha Roy
facts_of_case: Matrimonial Suit No.380 of 2010 was instituted by Usha Roy for a decree of divorce by dissolution of the marriage solemnized with Deo Prakash on 10th March 2004.

legal_principles.principle: The intention to bring cohabitation permanently to an end must be proved.
legal_principles.held: This court finds that the intention to bring cohabitation permanently to an end, on the part of the respondent husband has not been proved.

legal_principles.principle: Desertion means desertion of the petitioner by the other party to the marriage without reasonable cause and without the consent or against the wish of such party.
legal_principles.held: The expression 'desertion' has been defined in the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 to mean desertion of the petitioner by the other party to the marriage without reasonable cause and without the consent or against the wish of such party.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming desertion to prove that the other spouse has deserted them for a continuous period of not less than 2 years.
legal_principles.held: Nothing is available on the record to ascertain as to when the said execution case has been filed by the respondent husband.

outcome.final_order: The husband's appeal was allowed, and the judgment in Matrimonial Suit No.380 of 2010 was set aside.
